component.name: xTux
component.summary: Play your Xbox PC games on Linux

description.p: xTux signs you in with your Microsoft account, installs the PC games you own or play with PC Game Pass and starts them with the Tux-Force Wine build, with the licenses Microsoft grants your account. It is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with Microsoft or Xbox.
A guided setup downloads Wine, prepares the prefix and finds your game folders, including those of Windows drives.
